extracted_details.description_text: Version 120.8.4.0, dated 2026-05-06, is the exact version supplied in the input and INF. INFDescriptionData was semantically analyzed: it identifies a Surface system-class package matching ACPI\MSHW0530 on Windows 10 build 19041 or later, installs SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys, and references Surface power-policy provisioning packages for Windows 10 and Windows 11. The INF describes KIP support, display backlight power-estimation points, power-related registry settings, a long-press screen-refresh setting, and BitLocker request limits; these are package configuration details, not confirmed release-note changes. Exact-version release notes and official product-page details could not be retrieved in this session, and the provided Intel Management Engine links do not identify this Surface package, so no previous, latest, or family-version notes are claimed.
key_components: SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys, registered as the SurfaceIntegrationDriver kernel service with demand start
Three referenced power-policy provisioning packages: defaults, Windows 10 defaults, and Windows 11-0 defaults
A 14-point backlight power curve, with brightness-percentage and backlight-power values configured for Windows energy estimation
Display panel energy-estimation values for power floor, VSync delta, DPI factor, and area factor
SurfaceService PlatformKipSupported registry value enabling platform KIP support
Windows power settings affecting battery discharge-time estimate visibility and screen refresh after a long power-button press
BitLocker fvevol request-limit registry values for encryption, decryption, and crypto requests per I/O
key_functionalities: Associates the package with ACPI\MSHW0530 on eligible 64-bit Windows installations starting at build 19041.
Provides OS-specific Surface power-policy provisioning package paths for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
Enables the KIP-supported platform setting, which the INF describes as enabling KIP power-saving features.
Configures display backlight power-estimation data for Windows energy estimation.
Sets power-management behavior to hide the estimated remaining battery discharge time and enable screen refresh following a long power-button press.
Raises BitLocker encryption, decryption, and per-I/O crypto request limits to 0x40; the INF comment associates the encryption-request limit with SSD performance under BitLocker.
The INF supplies configuration content only; it does not document version-specific fixes or changes.
extracted_details.major_components_functionalities_descrip: The enrichment is based on the exact supplied version 120.8.4.0 and the complete INFDescriptionData, which was semantically analyzed. The INF matches the Surface integration device ID ACPI\MSHW0530 on 64-bit Windows 10 build 19041 or later and installs a demand-start kernel driver. It references default, Windows 10, and Windows 11 power-policy packages and configures KIP support and display backlight energy-estimation data. It also sets battery-estimate visibility and power-button screen-refresh behavior, plus BitLocker request limits that the INF says are intended to improve SSD performance under BitLocker. No exact-version, previous-version, latest-version, or family release notes were available to confirm changes beyond the INF configuration.
impact_details: Power consumption and platform power-saving behavior may be affected by the KIP-supported setting and installed power-policy packages.
Windows display energy estimates may be affected by the configured 14-point backlight power curve and display panel estimation values.
The displayed estimated time remaining until battery discharge is hidden by the configured registry value.
The configured power-button long-press setting enables screen refresh behavior.

BitLocker I/O throughput may be affected by the configured encryption, decryption, and per-I/O crypto request limits; the INF specifically comments that the encryption-request limit is intended to improve SSD performance under BitLocker.
The INF does not establish specific model names beyond the ACPI\MSHW0530 hardware ID, or confirm firmware changes.
